_comment: Referral partner registry. `code` is the public ?ref= code in the partner's link. `attio` maps the code to the partner's CRM record (Companies or People) so submissions link to it. `portalKeyHash` is the SHA-256 hex of the partner's portal access key — the plaintext key is given to the partner once and never stored. Set active:false to shut a partner off (revokes portal sessions too). `aliases` (optional) lists extra vanity spellings — /<alias> redirects with the canonical code, and ?ref=<alias> resolves to the same partner.
